feat: apply JSON Patches (RFC 6902)

Adds applyPatch(document, patch) with the six operations add, remove,
replace, move, copy and test. The input is never mutated: the patch is
validated up front and applied to a structured clone, so a failing or
invalid patch leaves the input untouched.

Pointer parsing is shared with resolvePointer, so both validate
references the same way.
